about.en: Rio Tinto is an Anglo-Australian mining group producing iron ore, aluminium, copper and lithium. RIO represents the American depositary shares of Rio Tinto plc listed on the New York Stock Exchange, each representing one ordinary share, kept distinct from the ordinary shares traded in London (RIO.L) and Rio Tinto Limited shares in Sydney (RIO.AX). Derivative venues quote it in USD under the RIO ticker.
